evidence: Labeled Fuzzing and adds a new fuzzing harness in src/test/fuzz/p2p_transport_serialization.cpp
rationale: Adds fuzz coverage for untrusted BIP 324 P2P transport byte streams where existing targets only tested honest peer handshakes. While exercising untrusted network input covers a high-risk path, adding preventative fuzz target coverage without an identified bug or flaky test is worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
